problem_text: Write a function to find the similar elements from the given two tuple lists.

conversation.content: Can you help me with my function "similar_elements"? I keep gettin syntax errors and can't figure out wat's wrong.

    return tuple(set(tuple1) & set(tuple2))
Why did Python say 0/3 tests passed? There's a missing colon at the end of the function definition. It should be: `def similar_elements(tuple1, tuple2):`.

def similar_elements(tuple1, tuple2):
    return tuple(set(tuple1) | set(tuple2))
It looks like the issue might be related to missing colons or brackets. Try adding colons after the function definition and ensure all blocks are properly closed. Works perfectly, thanks!

    return tuple(set(tuple1) & set(tuple2))
